outcome: Rate of general anesthesia for cesarean delivery
Impact of a dedicated obstetric anesthesia team on anesthesia practice
cohort: All parturients who underwent cesarean delivery at a university hospital between 2010 and 2019
finding: The rate of general anesthesia for cesarean delivery decreased significantly after the formation of a dedicated obstetric anesthesia team in 2015, primarily due to a decrease in its use for pregnancies complicated by placenta previa.
mod_finding: The decrease in general anesthesia for cesarean delivery was partly attributed to a reduction in its use for cases with placenta previa.
